units.source_text: 最先是河内那家的远亲举行葬礼。

en.t: First, a distant relative of the Kawauchi family held a funeral.
The deceased was the mourner's mother.

units.source_text: 她年事已高，儿孙满堂，有的孙子年近三十。

en.t: She was advanced in years, blessed with many children and grandchildren, and some of her grandchildren were nearly thirty.

units.source_text: 再说她长期患病，经过精心治疗和护理，可以说是到了极乐世界，死而无憾。

en.t: Besides, she had been ill for a long time, and after careful treatment and nursing, one could say she had gone to paradise with no regrets in death.

units.source_text: 我亲眼看见丧主那副沮丧的神情，以及死者的孙女们泛红的脸面，

en.t: I saw with my own eyes the mourner's downcast expression and the flushed faces of the deceased woman's granddaughters,

units.source_text: 他们的悲哀也传染给我了。

en.t: and their sorrow infected me as well.

units.source_text: 然而，我却无心怀念死者，哀悼她的死。

en.t: Yet I had no heart to remember the deceased or mourn her death.

units.source_text: 就是在灵前烧香，我也不知道长眠在棺椁里的是什么人，

en.t: Even when I burned incense before the spirit tablet, I did not know who it was that lay in eternal sleep inside the coffin,

units.source_text: 每每忘却世上曾存在过这样一个人。

en.t: and I often forgot that such a person had ever existed in the world.
